b04.title: native binding
b04.name: translate_native_binding

inputs.name: canonical_result
inputs.presence: Conditionally present under B04.input_presence and the exact selected existing member/native branch; present_value includes permitted null, successful_no_value requires explicit existing permission.

inputs.name: canonical_error
inputs.presence: Conditionally present under B04.input_presence. When present it is the unchanged canonical_error record; absence is legitimate, not a fabricated ok error.

output.name: native_result
output.error_contract: Existing authority and copied member errors. Naming adds no outcome.

algorithm.action: Translate each result and/or error channel that is actually present under the exact selected existing member/native profile/refinement. Preserve result-only, error-only and supported both-channel cases, including valid partial/full output with reported error. Keep present nullable results, declared successful no-value and absent failed/inactive results distinct. Preserve the existing native return/output/status, diagnostic-state or exception convention; do not choose a new error policy.
Preserve no-value, enum and structured error meanings.
Apply only declared capability limitations and named native lifecycle refinements.

b04.algorithm_authority: design.md section 2; SDK §4.1/6.4; accepted Swift binding

canonical_errors.rule: Preserve the existing canonical error code and structured fields. No new error is introduced.

return_binding.name: native_result
return_binding.producer: Translate all actually present supported channels through the exact existing native member/profile/refinement; preserve actual valid partial/full results and any declared reported/retained error.
return_binding.refusals: Existing failure may throw or report status/error, retain a diagnostic alongside a usable result, or accompany permitted partial output. Preserve that already specified policy and valid outputs; do not erase values, fabricate inactive channels or introduce exception/result envelopes.

input_presence.scope: Private logical channel presence specialized to the exact existing member/native profile/refinement. No new public result envelope or universal partial-result policy.

value_contracts.canonical_result: Exact existing selected result type/nullability; methods/attributes use returns, fields/predicates use type/nullable. Existing C buffer/capacity or other typed receiver refinements retain their declared valid partial/full outputs.
value_contracts.canonical_error: The unchanged non-null canonical failure record when present. An absent error is legitimate and is never a fabricated success error code.

supported_combinations.admission: The selected existing member/profile returns a value without a reported error.
The selected existing failure/exception branch supplies no result.
Only when the selected existing member/profile/refinement supplies both, including existing partial-output/status or usable-result/retained-error branches.
Explicit existing declared void/null/no-value success; not inferred from a missing result key or an inactive result channel.
Only if an exact existing no-value/diagnostic branch explicitly supports this combination; no universal permission is introduced.

invariants: Absent is not a value. A present null/None/nil result remains present and is valid only under its exact existing nullable result contract.
Successful declared no-value is distinct from failure without a result and from an absent inactive channel.
Determine channel presence from the actual selected operation branch and native return/status/output/diagnostic contract, never truthiness or a null sentinel alone.
Do not discard a valid partial/full result because an error is reported; do not force an exception where the existing policy retains/logs an error.
Do not create a result on an error-only branch, invent a placeholder error on success, attach new exception fields, or add new public success/error conventions.
A native exception can represent the existing failure instead of a returned error channel. Existing returned/output values and declared diagnostic state are preserved.
Missing specialization/evidence is INCOMPLETE. Neither channel absent alone proves success; an existing successful no-value contract must be explicitly established.

consumer_rules: Native projection copies runtime logical rows and all ordered call-action descriptors exactly. Workflow entries are separate and never native calls.

Each runtime adds applicable and declaration (or an approved exclusion with exact catalog selector). Declaration binds each logical input by parameters with canonical_name, concept_ref, native_type, projection, ownership; typed receivers/contexts may implement the projection.

Types cover all 174 concepts with exact copied logical shape, concrete native_type/declaration, ownership and cleanup. Closed model/selector unions must not become generic Any/object/dict/void pointers. Existing finite JSON domain types retain exact JsonValue semantics.

Declaration source is candidate-relative path and actual SHA256. Declaration includes symbol, actual signature, result, status, visibility, refusal, async and lifetime. result includes canonical_name, concept_ref, native_type, ownership and cleanup.

Each call_action additionally binds callee_id, arguments (canonical_name/concept_ref/native_type/expression/ownership), result_type, owner and cleanup; action/source_selector/caller identity remain unchanged.

Actual observations require individually invoked runtime and edge entries, each tied to selected native profile, fixture/value variant, candidate source/build hashes, exact declared signature, concrete projections, result/refusal and cleanup. Later edges are invoked independently rather than pretending an unimplemented caller algorithm ran.

types must be concrete S-slot declarations, not copied planned assessment status. c optional modules are capabilities within c, never new native_profile strings. TS browser actual entry observation must occur in browser; Python imported_module must resolve under candidate python/src.

Descriptor controls are labelled structural_control; verifier tests may validate those descriptors but shape_accepted remains false. Actual native acceptance is unavailable without invocation evidence and successful native compile/type/load/link gates.

Observation classification is reused_callable, private_unimplemented_refusal, approved_profile_unsupported or construction_failure. Private refusal is incomplete body shape, never a valid result or behavior success.

B04 validates independent channel presence against exact selected existing member contract. Qualified partial/status or retained diagnostic branches are explicitly enumerated; null/error getter values and successful no-value are distinct from absent channels. No blanket C failure-clears-output rule.
